name: Blockhead Bot
description: Adds Blockhead Bot to the Vehicle Spawn brick's list. In its builder's mini-game it arms itself and fights, searches dated sightings shared by allies, and may crew eligible ground vehicles as a driver, gunner or passenger. It can push eligible loose hazards through walking contact and use grabbing tools such as the Gravity Gun. Roles are opportunistic: bots leave human seats alone and abandon unsafe or blocked actions. Bots of the same builder are allies. Outside mini-games it strolls harmlessly near its brick.
